To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
SmartClick provides a new way of user interaction with wireless Web services.
SmartClick enables users of handheld devices to get the desired information and services more easily, more quickly, and more efficiently than the traditional Web service navigation.
SmartClick can be used to improve the user experience of mobile Internet access by reducing user interactions and by increasing the usability of the Web services.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of an effective and efficient user interface for wireless Web services, which will be a key enabler to the success of mobile commerce and mobile information service.
the design of user-centered wireless Web service, which is a new way to deliver Web services in a wireless network environment.
developing the SmartClick technology for human-centered wireless Internet access.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
SmartClick is a novel approach to enable users to explicitly express intentions or preferences with minimum clicks, thus providing an easy and efficient navigation of the wireless Web services.
SmartClick can provide users a more efficient and effective way to access wireless Web services with minimal user interaction.
SmartClick is a novel approach to achieve user-centered mobile information services.

we have developed a new approach to provide a more effective way to access the Web services.
we have developed a new paradigm for the design of user-centered wireless Web service and implemented a middleware support for SmartClick.
we have developed an effective and user-centered approach to wireless Web service.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the user-centered wireless Web service design is a viable solution to the current limitations of wireless Web service.
we have shown that the design of user-centered wireless Web service is feasible and effective.
the user-centered design is an important factor to achieve a better wireless Web service.
